Messages.Author: Talonz
Messages.Body:
I noticed that the text for Ventrue HQ has changed slightly;

"During a referendum, you may tap this card to gain 3 votes."

So presumably this could give you votes during a bloodhunt?

If so, what about other vote locations like the city gangrel
connections that by their old text still refer to the pol action? Can
these be presumed to refer to a referendum instead as well or are they
hosed?

T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Talonz wrote:
>
> I noticed that the text for Ventrue HQ has changed slightly;
>
> "During a referendum, you may tap this card to gain 3 votes."
>
> So presumably this could give you votes during a bloodhunt?

Yes. This is not a functional change. Ventrue HQ has always been
able to supply votes in a bloodhunt.

> If so, what about other vote locations like the city gangrel
> connections that by their old text still refer to the pol action? Can
> these be presumed to refer to a referendum instead as well or are they
> hosed?

The ones that restrict themselves to political actions cannot be used
during a bloodhunt referendum, since that is not a political action.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"reyda" <true_...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:3d9369b9$0$24635$79c1...@nan-newsreader-03.noos.net...



No. That is, they are indivisible (cannot be divided).

From the Camarilla Edition rulebook, [6.3.3] "Gaining Votes":

"Each vote cast is cast either "for" or "against" the referendum, and
a Methuselah may cast some of her votes in favor and some against, as
she chooses, with the restriction that ***all of the votes from each given
vampire or other source must be cast in agreement as a group.***"

(emphasis added.)

Josh
